title: gnaphalon rupestre
intro: Gnaphalon rupestre, commonly known as the mountain gnaphalium, is a flowering plant species in the aster family that is native to mountainous regions of the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Gnaphalon rupestre include its ability to aid in the relief of anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Gnaphalon rupestre are thought to contribute to its potential therapeutic applications, including its use as a natural remedy for stress relief and skin conditions.
